name: neighborhood-discovery-static-vanilla-js
description: Hyperlocal Neighborhood Directory & Spot Mapper built with Static HTML, Vanilla JavaScript (ES Modules), and modern Google Maps Platform APIs.

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{for(const f of ['index.html','app.js','styles.css','server.mjs']){if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Missing '+f);}console.log('Static vanilla JS build verification passed.');})"
